text: Managing a team is a skill that takes time to develop. Good communication is the foundation of any successful team. As a leader, you should share clear goals and listen to your team members' ideas. Delegation is also important; you cannot do everything yourself, so trust your colleagues with tasks that match their strengths. Giving regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued. Motivation comes from recognising good work and supporting your team when things are difficult. Finally, when conflicts happen, stay calm and listen to both sides. A good leader solves problems fairly and keeps the team focused on shared goals.
